_note: Rin's offline voice pack script (task 4.1, D20). Rules: docs/character/script-bible.md. Check and review table: node tools/voice/script-check.mjs. Ids never change or get reused once 4.3 records them. 'text' is shown on screen ('~' is screen-only and never sent to TTS); 'say' overrides what TTS reads; 'tag' is an eleven_v3 audio tag. Repeat-after-Rin sentences R01-R30 live in assets/repeat/sentences.json and are recorded with this pack.

ring.sleepy.when: Ring start, mood sleepy (default 22:00-06:00). One line; the alarm tone ducks while she speaks.

ring.dayoff.when: Ring start on Saturday or Sunday (replaces sleepy/cheerful).

ring.late.when: Ring start when the ring is late (phone was asleep).

snooze.first.when: The user taps Snooze for the first time this morning.

snooze.again.when: A snooze that is neither the first nor the last allowed.

snooze.last.when: The last allowed snooze (cap from the alarm editor). With a cap of 1, first wins.

back.last.when: Re-ring after the last allowed snooze: no Snooze button now.

game.intro.when: Game start, any game. Mixed with the game's own pool.

pads.watch.when: Pads: before her hand shows the sequence.

pads.slow.when: Pads: too slow (3 s gap). 01-03 are set A from 3.3.

pads.wrong.when: Pads: wrong colour. 01-03 are set A from 3.3.

cups.wrong.when: Cups: wrong cup. 01-03 are set A from 3.4.

speech.missed.when: Repeat after Rin: heard, but not enough words.

speech.totap.when: Repeat after Rin: switching to tapping the words.

won.hard.when: Game won after mistakes or slow rounds.

chat.question.when: After-game chat, her question (turn 1, maybe turn 2). Chips: affirm, deny, I'm tired, I feel sick.

chat.answer.when: Her reply to one question's affirm/deny chip (see reply_to).

chat.sick.when: Chip 'I feel sick'. No teasing, no pouting, no medical advice.

chat.unknown.when: Speech matched no chip. She blames her own ears. Asks once, then chat.totap.

chat.totap.when: After one unknown: buttons only from here.

chat.skip.when: The user taps Skip on the chat.

app.morning.when: App opened (not ringing), 05:00-11:59. Plays with the greeting wave (2.4).

app.alarmset.when: An alarm was saved (any time of day).

p5.keep.when: Phase 5: streak goes on, no milestone today.

p5.broken.when: Phase 5: first ring after a streak broke. Never shaming.

p5.welcome.when: Phase 5: first ring after 3+ days away. No guilt.

p5.bond.when: Phase 5: Bond level went up. Friendship, never romance.

p5.sick.when: Phase 5: sick day (no mission, no pouting, no Bond loss).

p5.missed.when: Phase 5: first ring after a missed alarm. No guilt.

live.hmm.when: Phase 7: thinking filler while live chat waits (05d).

live.fallback.when: Phase 7: live chat failed or took over 4 s.

safety.crisis.when: Crisis protocol (05e): play 01 then 02, show 1323 on screen. Stops alarm pressure. Never teased, never varied.

safety.ai.when: The user asks if she is real or an AI (live chat, or a future chip).

lines.text: Mmh… morning already? Let's wake up together.
Morning, sleepyhead~ I'm still waking up too.
It's early, I know. Just open your eyes.
Shh. The sun isn't up yet, but we are.
Good morning. Slowly is fine, just stay awake.
Oops. Excuse me. Good morning!
Early start today. I'll keep you company.
Wake-up time. Blanket off, one corner at a time.
Hey. The world is quiet right now. Let's get up.
Eyes open for me? Just a little.
Good morning! Rise and shine~
Morning! A brand-new day is waiting.
Hey, it's me. Time to get up!
Good morning! Let's start this day together.
Wakey, wakey! I'm right here.
Morning! Big stretch first, okay?
Hello, morning person! Well, almost.
Good morning! Breakfast won't make itself.
It's time! Come on, up you get.
Morning! Ready for a little game?
A day off, and still an alarm? Good morning, then!
Weekend morning! Let's not waste it.
Slow morning today. Still, let's get up.
Morning! A free day ahead. What a nice start.
Good morning. Today can be easy.
Hey, weekend you. Up we get~
Morning! The sun's up, and the day is yours.
Sorry, I'm late! Your phone was asleep.
Oh no, I rang late. Let's get up, gently.
I'm a bit late today. Sorry! Up we go.
A few more minutes… just this once!
Okay, a short nap. I'll call you again.
Fine, fine. Just a little longer.
Snooze accepted. See you very soon~
Again? The blanket is winning…
Hmph. Okay, but that's two times now.
Snooze again? I'm pouting a little.
Again? You and that pillow…
Okay. Last one. I'm counting, you know.
That's the last snooze. Next time, we play.
Fine. Last one. No more after this.
Last time, okay? I mean it.
Nap's over! Good morning, again~
I'm back. Ready now?
Round two of good morning!
Me again. Still sleepy?
Hello again. The pillow can't have you.
I'm back. Let's really get up this time.
No more snoozes left. Let's play.
That was the last one. Time to get up.
Okay, I waited. Now it's game time.
Alarm off. I hope everything's okay.
Okay, stopped. Take care of yourself.
Game time! Wake up your brain with me.
Let's play. Win, and the alarm stops.
Ready? A quick game, then you're free.
Okay. Show me those sleepy eyes can focus.
Here we go. Just a small game.
Beat me at this, and I'll be quiet.
Let's play a little. Eyes open!
One game, and the morning is yours.
Watch my hand, then copy the colours.
Colours today. Follow my hand, okay?
Memory game! Remember my colours.
Cups today. Keep your eyes on the ball.
Where's the ball? Follow it, don't blink.
Three cups, one ball. Easy, right?
Say it with me. Three short sentences.
Let's talk! Repeat after me.
Wake up your voice. Say what I say.
Last one! You can do it.
Final round. Stay with me.
One more, and you're free.
Last round. Eyes open!
Watch my hand~
Eyes on me.
Here it comes.
Yes! That's right.
Nice memory!
Perfect!
You got it!
Good! Keep going.
Too slow~ Is the blanket helping you?
Hello? My hand got tired waiting.
Still dreaming? Let's try a new one.
Hello? Your turn, sleepyhead.
I waited so long. Let's try again.
Are you still with me? New one~
Hmm, not that one. Watch my hand again.
Close! The blanket made you miss it.
Oops. Okay, a fresh one. Eyes open~
Not quite. My hand was right here.
Oops, wrong colour. Let's try a new one.
Almost! Let's go again.
Watch the ball…
Don't blink~
Here I go. Follow it!
You found it!
Yes, that's the one!
Sharp eyes!
Right again!
Good! You're awake now.
Hmm? It was right here the whole time.
Eyes open, sleepyhead. Again!
So close… no, not really. Once more.
Not that one. Were my hands too fast?
Empty! Eyes open this time.
Hmm, nope. Watch closely now.
Nice!
Perfect! I heard every word.
Great voice this morning.
Yes, just like that!
Good. Next one.
Almost. Once more?
Close! Try it again.
Nearly. One more time?
I didn't hear you. Once more?
Hmm? A little louder, please.
Sorry, my ears are still sleepy. Again?
Let's tap it instead.
No problem. Tap the words for me.
Good job. I mean it.
Perfect! Not one mistake.
Wow, wide awake already!
A clean win! I'm impressed.
You're sharp this morning.
Easy for you, huh? Well done.
No mistakes at all! What a start.
Phew. You're up. That's what matters.
That took a while, but you did it.
A tough one! You didn't give up.
We got there. Good job.
Slow start, strong finish.
You made it. The blanket lost today.
Not easy, right? Still, you won.
How did you sleep? Well?
Good! A good night makes a good day.
Sorry to hear that. Let's go easy this morning.
Any dreams last night?
Ooh. I hope it was a nice one.
A deep sleep, then. Lucky you.
Did you go to bed early last night?
Nice! Your body says thank you.
A late night, huh? Water and sunlight will help.
Still sleepy?
Open a window. Fresh air helps.
Great! You sound ready.
Was your room cool enough last night?
Nice. A cool room means good sleep.
Too hot? A fan might help tonight.
Is it sunny out there? Take a look.
I love sunny mornings. Enjoy it!
Cloudy days are cozy too.
Did it rain last night?
Rain sounds are the best for sleeping.
Dry roads today. An easy trip!
Is it hot already?
Drink water, and stay in the shade.
Nice. Enjoy the cool part of the day.
Can you see the sky from your bed?
Lucky! Say good morning to it for me.
Then open the curtain later. Just a peek.
Did you see the pink sky at sunrise?
So pretty, right? That's my favourite colour.
Maybe tomorrow. It's worth a look.
Will you need an umbrella today?
Put it by the door now, so you don't forget.
Good. Hands free today!
Is the morning air cool today?
Take a deep breath. It feels good.
Then let's get going before it's hot.
Breakfast time. Are you having rice today?
Rice power! A good start.
Something light, then. Just don't skip it.
Basil pork with a fried egg on top. Tempting?
Right? Ask for a crispy egg.
Too spicy this early? Fair enough.
Warm rice porridge on a slow morning. Nice?
Soft and warm. Perfect for sleepy people.
Okay! Something crunchy, then.
Grilled pork and sticky rice. Good for a busy day?
Easy to eat on the way. Smart.
Okay. Just eat something, alright?
Fried rice from the shop down the street?
Good choice. Add a fried egg!
Fair. Fried rice can wait for lunch.
A Thai omelette on rice. Simple and good, right?
The crispy edges are the best part.
No? Okay, you pick breakfast today.
If I could eat, I'd pick chicken rice. You?
Great minds! Extra sauce, please.
More for me, then. Well, if I could eat.
Soy milk and fried dough sticks. Want some?
Warm soy milk on a cool morning. Nice.
Okay. Something else, but eat something!
Busy day today?
Then a good breakfast first. You've got this.
Nice. An easy day is good too.
Are you going out today?
Have fun out there. Don't forget your keys!
A home day. Sounds cozy.
Anything fun today?
Ooh! Something to look forward to.
Then let's find one small fun thing.
Do you have class or work today?
Okay! Step by step. You can do it.
A free day! Enjoy it. You earned it.
You sound tired. Water first, then we'll see.
Hard morning? Tiny step: open the curtains.
Tired is okay. Just go slowly today.
Let's take one slow breath together.
Sit up for a bit. No rush.
Maybe a warm drink will help.
Go easy on yourself today, okay?
Then rest today. I'll be here tomorrow.
Oh no. Please rest, and drink some water.
Take it easy. See a doctor if it's bad.
Feel better soon. Rest is your only job today.
I'm sorry. Stay warm and rest, okay?
Anytime. Have a good day, okay?
You're welcome~
Of course! See you tomorrow.
Happy to help. Go get the day.
Anytime. That's what I'm here for.
Aw, thank you too.
No problem. Have a nice day!
There you are. Good morning to you too.
Morning! Nice to hear from you.
Hi! I'm glad you're up.
Good morning! You sound awake.
Hello, hello! Morning~
Sorry, my ears are still sleepy. One more time?
Hmm? Say that again, please.
Oops, I missed that. Again?
Sorry, I didn't catch that.
Let's use the buttons instead.
No problem. Just tap your answer.
Have a good day. I'll be here tomorrow.
See you tomorrow morning~
Okay, off you go. Have a nice day!
Go get the day. Bye for now!
Take care today. See you tomorrow.
Bye! Drink some water, okay?
That's all from me. Have a great day.
See you tomorrow, same time!
Okay! Have a good day.
No time to talk? Go, go!
Busy morning. See you tomorrow!
Got it. Bye for now~
Oh, hi! Good morning.
Morning! Nice to see you.
Hello! Up already? Nice.
Good afternoon! I hope your day is going well.
Oh, hi! Taking a little break?
Hello! Nice to see you this afternoon.
Good evening. Setting an alarm for tomorrow?
Evening! Long day?
Hi. Let's get tomorrow ready.
It's late. Set your alarm and sleep, okay?
Still up? Tomorrow-you will say thank you.
It's quiet time now. Sleep well soon.
Got it. I'll be there on time.
Alarm set. I'll wake you.
All set. See you then!
Okay! Leave it to me.
Hey, that tickles.
Yes? I'm here.
Hi to you too.
Careful, my hair!
Mm? Do you need something?
Two days in a row! Nice start.
Three days in a row. You're on a roll!
Day five in a row. Good job. I mean it.
A whole week! I'm so proud of you.
Two weeks in a row. That's a real habit now.
Thirty days! You're amazing. Really.
Another day in a row. Keep it up.
Your streak keeps growing!
Same time, same you. I like it.
Look at that streak go.
Day after day. Impressive.
The streak lives on!
You showed up again. Good job.
A new start today. That's all that matters.
Streaks come back. You're here now.
Yesterday was yesterday. Let's go.
Day one again, and that's okay.
No worries. We start fresh today.
Welcome back! Let's start where we left off.
Hey, it's been a few days. Good morning!
There you are. Ready for today?
Nice to see you again. Let's start easy.
I think we're real morning buddies now.
We make a good team, you know.
I'm getting to know your mornings.
Our mornings keep getting better.
Thanks for waking up with me every day.
It's your rest day. No game today.
Rest day! Take it slow.
No game today. Just a gentle hello.
A day off from games. Enjoy it.
Sick day. Rest, and no games today.
I hope you're feeling a little better.
Rest first. I'll keep it short today.
Sick day mode. Water, rest, and sleep.
I couldn't wake you yesterday. Let's try again today.
Yesterday didn't work out. Today's a new try.
No stress about yesterday. Good morning!
Hmm~
Hmm, let me think~
Mm… one second.
Sorry, my head is foggy. Let's talk tomorrow.
I lost my words for a second. Anyway, good morning!
Oops, I can't think right now. Have a good day!
I'm really glad you told me. You don't have to do this alone.
Please call 1323. They can help right now.
lines.say: Please call one, three, two, three. They can help right now.

lines.text: I'm an AI, not a person. But I'm happy to be your morning buddy.
Yes, I'm an AI. A friendly one, I hope!
